gate.title: TravelMateVR Command Center
gate.text: Manage users, partners, content, bookings, AI, support, revenue and platform security.
gate.demoNote: Demo access for review. In production, administrators sign in with their own account and two-step verification, and every permission is enforced by the server.
gate.realBackendNote: This is the real platform — the demo session is disabled here. Sign in with an account that has admin access instead; every permission is still enforced by the server regardless.
gate.role: Sign in with the permissions of

mfa.title: Set up two-factor authentication
mfa.text: Admin accounts must enroll an authenticator app before accessing the Command Center. Scan this QR code, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for authenticator app setup
mfa.manualHint: Can't scan it? Enter this code manually:
mfa.err: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
mfa.startErr: Couldn't start setup. Refresh the page to try again.

roleText.super_admin: Everything, including system settings and security changes.
roleText.admin: Run the platform day to day; security is read-only and system settings are hidden.
roleText.content_manager: Destinations, VR content, reviews, marketing and promotions.
roleText.support_agent: Support tickets, bookings, reviews; users are read-only.
roleText.finance: Bookings, analytics and reports; partners are read-only.

noAccess.title: You don't have access to this section
noAccess.text: Your role doesn't include this area. Ask a super administrator if you need access.

readOnly: You can view this section but your role can't change anything here.

dashboard.title: Good to see you, {{name}}
dashboard.text: The whole platform at a glance: people, partners, bookings, revenue and service.
dashboard.dataNote: Bookings, GMV, commission, guest markets and partner performance come from booking data. Users, conversion and non-commission revenue are sample values until analytics and billing are connected.
dashboard.geoNote: Lead traveller's country of residence on bookings.
dashboard.revenueNote: Commission from bookings; subscriptions, advertising and enterprise revenue are sample values.

users.text: Every account on TravelMateVR: travellers, partners, tourism boards and staff.
users.newThisMonth_one: {{count}} new signup in the last 30 days
users.newThisMonth_other: {{count}} new signups in the last 30 days
users.mfaReset: Two-step verification reset. The user will set it up again at next sign-in.
users.inviteNote: Staff must turn on two-step verification at first sign-in. Only super administrators can grant administrator roles.
users.realRoleNote: Invited staff get full admin access — there's no separate staff tier yet on the real account system.

partners.text: Partner directory, verification, commission and suspensions, plus applications and new listings waiting for review.
partners.suspendNote: Suspending a partner hides all their listings from travellers at once. Existing bookings are kept; review them in Bookings.
partners.noApplications: No applications yet. They arrive from the public “List your business” form.
partners.decideFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
partners.revokeReasonPh: Why this approval is being revoked
partners.revokeFailed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
partners.checks: Before approving: verify the tourism licence with the issuing authority, check the business registration, and confirm the contact by phone.
partners.noListings: No new listings waiting for review.
partners.listingChecks: Check that the description is accurate and specific, the price is realistic, and the listing doesn't duplicate an existing one.

destinations.text: Every destination with interest, bookings and the content tourism boards have published.
destinations.interestNote: Interest is a sample index of page views, 360° views and searches.

bookings.text: All bookings across partners. Handle disputes, refunds and resends here.
bookings.confirmText: This cancels the booking and refunds everything paid ({{amount}}) to the original payment method. The traveller and partner are notified.

vr.text: Every immersive experience and its publishing status. Only published experiences are visible to travellers.
vr.uploadHint: Equirectangular image (2:1) or 360° video. Files go to the processing pipeline (stitching check, compression, face blurring); choose processed media above once ready.
vr.fileErr: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP, TIFF, MP4, MOV or Insta360 file under 2 GB.
vr.narrationPh: Text read aloud with the browser's speech voice in the traveller's language.
vr.workflowNote: New experiences start as drafts: send to review, approve, then publish. Published experiences appear in the VR library and on destination pages.
vr.videoHint: Primary format. The 360° photo below, if set, is shown when the video can’t play.

ai.text: How travellers use AI TravelMate: questions, plans, feedback, failures, safety and cost.
ai.dataNote: {{count}} interactions were recorded on this device; the rest are sample data. Prompts are stored redacted.
ai.sampleNote: applies to interactions not made on this device.
ai.redaction: Emails and phone numbers are removed before prompts are stored. Flagged prompts get a safe, general answer.
ai.rulesModel: rule-based planner over the TravelMateVR catalogue
ai.costNote: the demo planner has no per-request cost; hosted models report tokens and cost through the gateway
ai.replaceable: The app talks to AI through one service interface (plan and respond). A hosted model can replace the demo planner on the server without changing any screens.

reviews.text: Approve new reviews, and hide published reviews that break the guidelines.
reviews.policy: Reviews are only removed when they break the review guidelines, never because they're negative. Every decision is audited.

marketing.text: Approve partner campaigns, featured placement and packages, and monitor everything running.
marketing.labelling: Promoted content is always labelled “Promoted” or “Featured”. AI TravelMate never ranks paid content above better matches without saying so.

promotions.text: All partner offers. The maximum partner discount is {{max}}%; change it in System settings.
promotions.note: Pause offers that mislead travellers (for example inflated “before” prices). Paused offers stop applying at checkout immediately.

analytics.text: GMV, take rate, revenue streams, demand and destinations across the platform.
analytics.streamsNote: Commission and service fees from bookings; the other streams are partly sample.

sustainability.text: Contributions, certification and community-led supply across all destinations.
sustainability.byCountry: Eco-certified or community-led listings by country

support.text: Questions from travellers and partners. Replies reach the traveller's ticket and notifications.
support.emptyText: Support requests from the Help Center appear here.

macro.received: Hi {{name}}, thanks for getting in touch. We're looking into this now and will update you shortly.
macro.refund: Hi {{name}}, we've issued the refund to your original payment method. It usually arrives within 5–10 business days.
macro.dates: Hi {{name}}, we've asked the partner about changing your dates and will confirm as soon as they reply.

reports.text: Download reports as CSV for finance, partners and compliance. Each download is recorded in the audit log.
reports.rangeNote_one: {{count}} booking in this range (applies to the bookings report).
reports.rangeNote_other: {{count}} bookings in this range (applies to the bookings report).
reports.privacy: Reports may contain personal data. Store them securely and delete them when no longer needed. Generated {{date}}.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.text: Every booking with price breakdown and payment status

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.text: Bookings, GMV and interest per destination

users.title: Users
users.text: Accounts by role and status (no names or emails)

ai.title: AI interactions
ai.text: Redacted prompts, answer types, latency and feedback

security.text: Who did what, unusual activity, data-protection requests and role permissions.
security.auditNote: The audit log is append-only. In production it's written by the server and kept for at least 2 years.
security.dsrNote: Requests must be completed within 30 days. Erasure keeps only what the law requires (for example accounting records).
security.enforced: These permissions are enforced by the server on every request; the interface only hides what a role can't use.

settings.text: Platform-wide configuration. Changes apply immediately and are recorded in the audit log.
settings.feeHint: Charged on base price and extras; shown on every booking.

flagText.aiPlanner: Planner and questions on /ai. When off, travellers see a short notice.
flagText.headsetMode: WebXR headset button in the 360° viewer.
flagText.partnerApplications: The public “List your business” form. When off, the page explains applications are paused.
flagText.reviews: Travellers can submit new reviews after a completed booking.

settings.maintenanceOn: Show a banner across the traveller site
settings.maintenancePh: e.g. Payments are briefly unavailable from 02:00 to 03:00 EAT.
settings.securityNote: Security settings are enforced by the authentication service; this demo records them only.

api.name: TravelMateVR API
api.text: Catalogue, bookings and accounts. Set VITE_DATA_SOURCE=http and VITE_API_BASE_URL.

payments.name: Payments
payments.text: Cards and mobile money through a PCI-compliant provider, configured on the server.

maps.name: Maps
maps.text: Map tiles. Set VITE_MAP_TILES_LIGHT/DARK with a domain-restricted key.

ai.name: AI gateway
ai.text: Hosted model behind the plan/respond interface, configured on the server.

messaging.name: Email, SMS and WhatsApp
messaging.text: Notification providers, configured on the server.

storage.name: Media storage
storage.text: 360° uploads and processing pipeline (stitching checks, compression, blurring).

settings.secrets: Provider keys and secrets live only on the server. They are never entered here or shipped in the app.
settings.creatorShareHint: Paid into the creator pool each month and split by the watch time of each creator's experiences. Shown on /creators as draft terms.
settings.lockoutHint: Sign-in is paused for this long after the attempts above fail in a row. The server enforces it per account and per IP address.
settings.viewRateHint: Paid to the creator of the experience, on top of the subscription share.
settings.qualifiedViewHint: A view counts once someone has watched this long. Repeat views by the same person in a day count once.
settings.tzsRateHint: Used to show shilling amounts at checkout. The payment provider confirms the final amount.
settings.bookingCountries: Countries open for booking and payment
settings.bookingCountriesHint: Everywhere else is preview-only: travellers can explore and plan, but not book or pay, and partners there cannot receive payouts.
settings.errCountries: Keep at least one country open.

creators.title: Creator applications
creators.creator: Creator
creators.notePh: e.g. Please send a 360° sample from Wadi Rum
creators.nextNote: Approving sends the creator agreement and opens a creator account for uploads. In this demo the decision is recorded here and in the audit log.
